notes: Wave-2 llvm-ar/llvm-objcopy/clang/lld ALL GREEN for aarch64-hobbyos (target aarch64-none-elf). No LLVM source patches were made (AD-3 held): every resolver was sysroot re-staging, compat sysroot-headers (fstream_inst.cpp, setjmp.S, fseeko/ftello + extern-C setjmp/longjmp declarations), gaps.c bodies (math via existing libc primitives, dl* no-loader semantics, rlimit INFINITY no-op, weak main bridge, __clear_cache, fseeko/ftello), empty stub archives for -lpthreads/-lrt/-ldl/-lm, -Wl,-z,norelro, staged-libc++ __config_site override (generated gitignored copy only; tracked config/__config_site untouched — L2 decides if fstream belongs in OS libc++), and fetch.sh SUBTREES += libunwind/include. install-distribution staged 227 MB to obj/selfhost/dist-staging: clang-21 120 MB, lld 69 MB, llvm-ar 13 MB, llvm-objcopy 9.6 MB (unstripped Release ELF; M2 strips/curates) + clang-resource-headers 272 headers / 15 MB (159 >8.3-name files = F8 curation item already in §10). RESDIR layout installed to usr/local/lib/clang/21/include. Wall times include iterate-and-fix cycles on -j64 (64-core host); pure compile of clang+lld dominates phase 2. pid_t fix (AD-12) verified present in current tree; previous blocker was simply a stale STAGED sysroot copy, not a code regression.
